about.headline: About AIoT Sphere Laboratory
about.description: The laboratory was developed to elevate intelligent technology education into a structured, standards-based, and innovation-driven learning environment.
about.history: AIoT Sphere Laboratory was founded from the concept of creating a shared space for experimentation, development, and knowledge transfer in AI, IoT, and Robotics through hands-on learning.
about.why: The laboratory was created to bridge the gap between theory and real prototyping, enabling learners to analyze, experiment, and improve their work through engineering processes.
about.objectives: The educational objectives emphasize advanced digital skills, teamwork, technology ethics, and the ability to communicate innovation outcomes.
about.integration: The integration of AI, IoT, and Robotics helps learners understand intelligent systems from data and sensors to AI models and real device control.
about.goals: The ultimate goal is to cultivate learners who can create innovation, develop foundational research skills, and continue into higher education or technology careers.

institution.visionSubtitle: Strategic direction of AIoT Sphere Laboratory
institution.visionBody: To elevate UTCC toward becoming a model university that develops prototype spaces for Physical AI, AI Orchestrated Systems, and Interactive AI Experience to enhance operational efficiency, create sustainability, and advance innovation from real-world implementation to global commercial development.
institution.backgroundSubtitle: From a future space to a tangible innovation ecosystem
institution.backgroundIntro: AIoT Sphere was established from the concept of creating a “future space” that brings together Artificial Intelligence (AI), Internet of Things (IoT), Interactive Experience, and an Innovation Ecosystem to transform learning, innovation development, and business collaboration into tangible reality.
institution.backgroundOrigin: The origin of AIoT Sphere came from the recognition that the world is entering an era where AI will become a fundamental infrastructure across every industry, including education, healthcare, business, services, and everyday life. At the same time, many people still perceive AI as distant and difficult to access.
institution.backgroundEcosystem: AIoT Sphere was therefore designed to be more than a traditional laboratory. It is a “Living Innovation Ecosystem” where people can learn, experiment, experience, and co-create real innovation through multiple spaces and projects.
institution.backgroundConcept: The core concept of AIoT Sphere is to create “AI that works in the real world” (Applied & Human-Centric AI), emphasizing the connection between technology, people, business, and experience to generate positive impact at the university, industry, and societal levels.
institution.backgroundCurrent: AIoT Sphere is currently being developed as a learning center for AI and emerging technology, an experimentation and innovation showcase space, a sandbox for prototype co-development with business sectors, a community hub for students, developers, startups, and partners, and a showcase platform for AI solutions and Physical AI innovation.
institution.backgroundGoal: Its long-term goal is to strengthen an AI ecosystem that sustainably connects education, business, and innovation, while elevating Thailand toward becoming a regional center for AI and future technology.
institution.missionSubtitle: Core role of AIoT Sphere Laboratory
institution.missionBody: To develop an AI innovation ecosystem that connects learning, experimentation, collaborative prototyping, and real-world implementation, while advancing knowledge in Physical AI, AI Orchestrated Systems, Applied AI, and Human-Centric AI to create sustainable value for the university, business sectors, industry, and society.
